title: HtmlTfoot
responsibility: Renders the native tfoot element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlTfoot.attributes
inputs.description: Native tfoot attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlTfoot.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native tfoot element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlTfoot
outputs.description: The actual native tfoot element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
